rows.en: Heh heh heh heh!! What do you think you're doing?
Y-you can see me? Did you really think drivel like that would rattle me!!
Save your bluster for the grave!!
Whoa, that was a close one.
Y-you dodged it!? Impossible!! Can you actually see me!?
I can see exactly where you're shooting from, y'know?
I can see right where you're shootin' from, y'know?
I can see exactly where you're shooting from!
...Now that I can see you, this fight is mine!
...Now that I can see you, this fight is mine!
I can see exactly where you're shooting from!
...Now that we can see you, the advantage is ours!
C-curse you!!! A mere gadget like that, exposing me...!!
So Invisible wasn't perfect... But whether you can see me or not, it makes no difference!
I'll send every one of you to hell with my own hands...!!
Nega Den-O!! We're killing these guys!!
Ugh... But it's already too late... The road to the "Gap in Time" has been sealed...
I-I refuse... to die in a place like thiiiis...!!
Weather Dopant... You still have this much power...!!
Weather Dopant... You still have this much power...!!
Weather Dopant... You still have this much power...!!
Weather Dopant... You still have this much power...!!
Weather Dopant... You still have this much power...!!
Weather Dopant... You still have this much power...!!
Just then, the roar of an engine rang out!
What!? What is that Gaia Memory...!!
But if the one using it is a mere insect...
Gwah!! I can't... see the attacks...!!
9.8 seconds... That's your time until despair.
Ngh... I'll be waiting for you in hell... Nuooooooaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!
Hey, there's someone further in there!?

notes.note: Denden Sensor: Memory Gadget name not in glossary; used Kamen Rider Wiki's 'Denden Sensor' (the Denden Memory from story_014 should match).
Momotaros's line ends in a surprised question mark; rendered as surprise that the sensor works ('Whoa, I can see ya!?').
No speaker recovered; clearly the Weather Dopant answering the heroes' 'I can see you'. He drops his usual polite register here, kept as harsher speech.
Attack grunt (same shape as 0.18), not a scoffing 'Hmph'.
Sentence trails off in the source ('with that thing, my form...'); rendered as 'A mere gadget like that, exposing me...!!' to keep the unfinished feel while staying readable.

No speaker recovered. Addresses Nega Den-O, so inferred as the Weather Dopant calling his ally into the boss fight; rougher than Weather's usual polite speech, so it could also be a mis-tagged line. Uncertain.
System message after the battle (Nega Den-O drops the pass).
Term for the passage/space between times rendered as "Gap in Time" in quotes as the source does; not in glossary. 0.43 Momotaros reacts to this line (0.42 is Nega Den-O's defeat laugh in between).
0.46-0.51 are the same Japanese for six party members; kept identical. Weather Dopant addressed directly ('You').
Accel catchphrase per glossary ('shake it off'): 'I'll shake off... everything!!'
Trial Memory voice line, caps in double quotes per style. 0.68 likewise.
No speaker recovered; inferred as the Weather Dopant sneering at Accel before being overwhelmed (0.65). Line trails off as in source.
Accel Trial's signature line (9.8 seconds = time until your despair).
Ankh's line ends with a surprised '!?'; kept as is.
proofread: source is an inverted question (what is that Memory?), not a recognition; old line implied Weather knew it.

report: 80/80 rows. Inferred speakers: 0.16, 0.17, 0.64 (Weather Dopant, confident); 0.38 (Weather Dopant addressing Nega Den-O, uncertain). New terms not in glossary: 'Denden Sensor', "Gap in Time". Sound effects/Memory voices in double quotes.
